data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'balaghah', meaning 'to make something clear' or 'to convey a message effectively'. This name carries the spiritual significance of being a clear and effective communicator in both words and actions. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
